:::{#exr-kl-slope}
#### Derivative of the divergence

Under the assumptions of @thm-score-mean-zero,
show that the derivative of the divergence of @def-model-kl-divergence is

$$\deriv{\param} \kldivf{\param_0}{\param} = -\Expp_{\param_0}\sb{\score(\param)},$$

where $\score(\param)$ is the [score](#def-score) evaluated at $\param$,
and the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) is taken with the data generated under $\param_0$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-kl-slope}

Write $\llik(\param) = \log \p(\vX \mid \param)$.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\kldivf{\param_0}{\param}
&= \Expp_{\param_0}\sb{\llik(\param_0) - \llik(\param)}
&& \text{(log of a ratio is a difference of logs)}\\
&= \Expp_{\param_0}\sb{\llik(\param_0)} - \Expp_{\param_0}\sb{\llik(\param)}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation)}\\
\deriv{\param} \kldivf{\param_0}{\param}
&= -\deriv{\param} \Expp_{\param_0}\sb{\llik(\param)}
&& \text{(the first term does not depend on $\param$)}\\
&= -\Expp_{\param_0}\sb{\deriv{\param} \llik(\param)}
&& \text{(exchange derivative and expectation)}\\
&= -\Expp_{\param_0}\sb{\score(\param)}
&& \text{(definition of the score)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
